names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 30 Ιουνίου, «Άγιος Πέτρος ο πρίγκιπας του Ορντύνσκϊυ, Ροστώβ», with the rank word left off.

death.note: saint.gr prints the year of death alone in its heading: «Άγιος Πέτρος ο πρίγκιπας του Ορντύνσκϊυ, Ροστώβ (; - 1290)», the year of birth left as a question mark.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026). He is a Russian saint and the Russian calendar is the source that will have his life; saint.gr has only the line.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).
